description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for git's commit graph and reachability functionalities. It sets up a complex commit graph, runs various tests related to commit reachability, historical traversal, branch base detection, reference comparisons, and other git internal diagnostics. The tests involve creating commits, branches, tags, and performing operations like merge, rev-list, and for-each-ref to verify the correctness of git's handling of commit reachability and graph traversal algorithms.

methods.name: run_all_modes
methods.description: Runs a specified command across multiple commit graph configurations, comparing the output against expected results stored in files, and restoring the original commit graph configuration after each test run.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive name, executing the given commands inside a subshell and checking for expected outcomes.
